items.title: A Picnic Plan
items.text:
A: Let's have a picnic on Saturday.
B: Good idea! But the news says it will rain in the morning.
A: Then we can go in the afternoon.
B: OK. I will make sandwiches.
A: Great. I'll bring fruit and a big blanket.
B: Should we meet at the lake?
A: Yes, at two o'clock, near the bridge.

qs.q: What will B make for the picnic?
qs.why: B가 "I will make sandwiches."라고 말했어요.

qs.q: What does A probably think about the weather?
o: It will rain all day on Saturday.
The rain will stop before the afternoon.
The lake will be too cold to visit.
It will be sunny in the morning.
qs.why: A는 "Then we can go in the afternoon."이라고 했으므로 오후에는 비가 그칠 것이라고 생각해요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, "near" means:
qs.why: "near the bridge"는 다리 가까이를 뜻하므로 close to예요.

qs.q: Why does A say, "Then we can go in the afternoon"?
o: To say that the picnic is a bad idea
To ask B to bring more food and drinks
To complain about what the news said
To suggest a fix for the rain problem
qs.why: 비가 온다는 문제에 대해 시간을 바꾸자는 해결책을 제안하는 말이에요.

items.title: The Lost Library Card
items.text:
A: Excuse me. I can't find my library card.
B: Don't worry. Do you remember your name and class?
A: I'm Mina, from Class 4.
B: Thanks. I found your name. I'll print a new card.
A: Is it free?
B: Yes, for the first time. Please be careful next time.
A: I will keep it in my pencil case.

qs.q: Where will Mina keep the new card?
qs.why: Mina는 "I will keep it in my pencil case."라고 말했어요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, "free" means:
qs.why: 카드를 새로 받을 때 돈이 드는지 묻는 맥락이므로 '무료'라는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: How does B probably feel about Mina's problem?
o: B is angry and in a hurry.
B is bored and a little sleepy.
B is sad and very worried.
B is calm and ready to help.
qs.why: B는 "Don't worry"라고 하며 새 카드를 출력해 주겠다고 해서 차분하고 도와주려는 태도예요.

qs.q: Why does B say, "Please be careful next time"?
o: To invite Mina to the library
qs.why: 카드를 또 잃어버리지 않도록 부드럽게 주의를 주는 말이에요.

items.title: Two Bikes
items.text:
A: Which bike do you like, the red one or the blue one?
B: The red one is faster, but it is heavier.
A: The blue one is cheaper, too.
B: I want to ride up hills, so I need a light bike.
A: Then the blue one is better for you.
B: You're right. I'll take the blue one.

qs.q: What is good about the red bike?
qs.why: B가 "The red one is faster"라고 말했어요.

qs.q: Which sentence is probably true?
o: The red bike is cheaper than the blue bike.
The blue bike is faster than the red bike.
The red bike is better for hills.
The blue bike is lighter than the red bike.
qs.why: 빨간 자전거가 더 무겁다고 했으므로 파란 자전거가 더 가벼워요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, "heavier" means:
qs.why: heavy는 무게가 많이 나간다는 뜻이고 heavier는 더 무겁다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does A say, "Then the blue one is better for you"?
qs.why: 언덕을 오를 가벼운 자전거가 필요하다는 B에게 알맞은 선택을 조언하는 말이에요.

items.title: A Stomachache
items.text:
A: You look pale. What's wrong?
B: My stomach hurts. I ate too much ice cream at lunch.
A: Maybe you should see the nurse.
B: Can you come with me?
A: Sure. Then I'll tell the teacher.
B: Thank you. I feel a little scared.
A: Don't worry. The nurse is kind.

qs.q: What did B eat too much of?
qs.why: B가 "I ate too much ice cream at lunch."라고 말했어요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, "pale" means:
qs.why: 배가 아픈 사람의 얼굴이 창백하다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: What will the speakers probably do next?
qs.why: A가 보건 선생님께 가 보라고 하고 같이 가 주겠다고 했어요.

qs.q: Why does A say, "Don't worry"?
qs.why: 무서워하는 B를 안심시키려는 말이에요.

items.title: At the Train Station
items.text:
A: Excuse me. When does the next train to the airport leave?
B: At 4:15. It leaves from Platform 3.
A: How long does it take?
B: About forty minutes.
A: Then I'll arrive at five. Thank you!
B: You're welcome. Hurry, you have only five minutes.

qs.q: Which platform does the train leave from?
qs.why: B가 "It leaves from Platform 3."이라고 했어요.

qs.q: About what time is it now?
qs.why: 기차는 4시 15분에 출발하고 5분밖에 안 남았다고 했으므로 지금은 약 4시 10분이에요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, "leaves" means:
qs.why: 기차가 승강장에서 출발한다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does B say, "Hurry"?
o: To say the train is late
To tell A to be quick
qs.why: 출발까지 5분밖에 남지 않아 서두르라고 재촉하는 말이에요.

items.title: A Surprise for Dad
items.text:
A: Dad's birthday is next week. What should we buy?
B: He likes reading. How about a book?
A: He has many books. Let's make a card and a cake instead.
B: Good idea! I'm going to bake it on Sunday.
A: I'll draw the card tonight.
B: He will be so surprised.

qs.q: What will B do on Sunday?
qs.why: B는 "I'm going to bake it on Sunday."라고 했고 it은 케이크예요.

qs.q: What does "instead" mean in the dialogue?
qs.why: 책을 사는 대신 카드와 케이크를 만들자는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: What can we guess about Dad?
o: He has no books at all at home.
He does not like to eat cake.
He will bake the cake by himself.
qs.why: "He will be so surprised."라는 말에서 아빠가 계획을 아직 모른다고 짐작할 수 있어요.

qs.q: Why does A say, "Let's make a card and a cake instead"?
o: To ask about the birthday date
To say Dad is too busy now
To refuse to help with it
qs.why: 책 대신 다른 선물을 하자고 제안하는 말이에요.

items.title: Weekend at the Beach
items.text:
A: How was your weekend?
B: Great! We went to the beach on Saturday.
A: Did you swim?
B: No, the water was too cold. We built a sandcastle.
A: That sounds fun. Was it big?
B: Yes, it was taller than me!
A: Wow! Did you take a picture?
B: Of course. I'll show you at lunch.

qs.q: Why didn't B swim?
o: B was too tired to swim.
B forgot to bring a swimsuit.
qs.why: B가 "the water was too cold"라고 말했어요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, "built" means:
o: found by chance on the sand
qs.why: 모래를 쌓아 모래성을 만들었다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: What will B probably do at lunch?
qs.why: B가 "I'll show you at lunch."라고 했고 그 대상은 사진이에요.

qs.q: Why does A ask, "Was it big?"
o: To say the beach was crowded
To ask for a bigger one
To end the talk right now
To find out more about it
qs.why: 모래성에 관심을 보이며 더 알고 싶어서 묻는 말이에요.

items.title: A Broken Robot
items.text:
A: Oh no! My robot's arm came off.
B: Let me see. Maybe we can fix it with glue.
A: Do we have any?
B: Yes, it's in the drawer under the desk.
A: Found it. But it's dry.
B: Then let's ask Mom for tape.
A: OK. I'll go ask her now.

qs.q: Where is the glue?
o: In the drawer under the desk
In the cabinet over the desk
In Mom's bag in the kitchen
In the box under the bed
qs.why: B가 "it's in the drawer under the desk"라고 했어요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, "came off" means:
qs.why: 로봇의 팔이 몸에서 떨어졌다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: What can we guess about the glue?
o: It is brand new and ready.
It is in Mom's room now.
It is too expensive to buy.
qs.why: 풀이 말라 버렸다고 해서 지금은 쓸 수 없다고 짐작할 수 있어요.

qs.q: Why does B say, "Then let's ask Mom for tape"?
o: To blame A for the problem
To say the robot is too old to fix
To offer another way to fix it
To ask Mom to buy a new robot
qs.why: 풀을 쓸 수 없으니 테이프라는 다른 방법을 제안하는 말이에요.

items.title: Video Call with Grandma
items.text:
A: I can't hear Grandma on the video call.
B: The sound is off. Click the little speaker.
A: Oh, now I hear her. She says hello!
B: Ask her about her garden.
A: Grandma, are your tomatoes red yet?
B: Listen, she says they will be ready next week.

qs.q: How can A fix the sound problem?
qs.why: B가 "Click the little speaker."라고 했어요.

qs.q: What can we guess about the tomatoes?
qs.why: 다음 주에 준비가 된다고 했으므로 아직 빨갛게 익지 않았어요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, "ready" means:
o: easy to find in the garden
qs.why: 토마토가 다 익어서 먹을 수 있다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does B say, "Ask her about her garden"?
qs.why: 할머니와 이야기할 화제를 제안하는 말이에요.

items.title: Where Is My Cap?
items.text:
A: Have you seen my cap?
B: Is it on the sofa?
A: No, I looked there.
B: Check behind the door. Last night I saw it near the shoes.
A: Found it! It was under the coat.
B: Next time, put it on the hook.
A: Good idea.

qs.q: Where was the cap?
qs.why: A가 "It was under the coat."라고 말했어요.

qs.q: What does B probably think about A?
o: A never wears a cap outside the house.
A has no set place for the cap.
A bought a new cap yesterday.
qs.why: B가 다음에는 고리에 걸라고 한 것으로 보아 A가 모자를 정해진 곳에 두지 않는다고 생각해요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, "hook" means:
o: a soft place to sit and rest
a kind of shoe for rain
a small box with a lid
qs.why: 모자를 거는 곳이므로 물건을 걸 수 있는 고리를 뜻해요.

qs.q: Why does B ask, "Is it on the sofa?"
o: To say the sofa is very dirty
To ask A to buy a new sofa
To suggest a place to look
To tell A to sit down
qs.why: 모자가 있을 만한 장소를 짚어 주며 찾는 것을 돕는 말이에요.

items.title: Before the Test
items.text:
A: I have a math test tomorrow. I'm nervous.
B: Did you study?
A: A little. I'm afraid of the fractions.
B: Let's practice together after school.
A: Really? That would help a lot.
B: I'll bring my notebook. We can meet in the library at four.

qs.q: What is A afraid of?
qs.why: A가 "I'm afraid of the fractions."라고 했어요.

qs.q: What can we say about A's preparation?
o: A is not fully ready yet.
A has already taken the test.
A does not want to study.
qs.why: "A little."이라는 대답으로 아직 충분히 공부하지 못했음을 알 수 있어요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, "nervous" means:
qs.why: 시험 전에 걱정되고 불안한 마음을 뜻해요.

qs.q: Why does B say, "Let's practice together after school"?
o: To say the test is easy
qs.why: 걱정하는 A에게 같이 연습하자며 도움을 제안하는 말이에요.

items.title: Cold Weather Tomorrow
items.text:
A: What's the weather going to be like tomorrow?
B: It will be windy and cold.
A: Then I won't wear my shorts.
B: Take a jacket and a hat, too.
A: Good. Are we still going to the soccer field?
B: Yes, but we'll go home early if it snows.

qs.q: What will A not wear tomorrow?
qs.why: A가 "I won't wear my shorts."라고 했어요.

qs.q: What will the speakers do tomorrow?
qs.why: 축구장에 간다고 했으므로 야외에서 놀 계획이에요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, "windy" means:
qs.why: 바람이 많이 분다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does A ask, "Are we still going to the soccer field?"
o: To say the field is far away
To ask for a ride there
qs.why: 날씨가 나빠도 계획이 그대로인지 확인하려는 질문이에요.

items.title: Dog or Cat?
items.text:
A: Do you want a dog or a cat?
B: A cat. Cats are quieter than dogs.
A: But dogs are more playful.
B: Yes, but they need a long walk every day.
A: I see. I have football practice, so a cat is easier for me too.
B: Then let's visit the pet shop on Sunday.

qs.q: What does B say about cats?
o: They need long walks every day.
qs.why: B가 "Cats are quieter than dogs."라고 했어요.

qs.q: What will the speakers probably get?
qs.why: 둘 다 고양이가 더 쉽다는 결론에 이르러 가게에 가기로 했어요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, "playful" means:
qs.why: 개가 같이 놀기를 좋아한다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does B say, "Then let's visit the pet shop on Sunday"?
qs.why: 결정을 한 뒤 일요일에 함께 갈 계획을 세우는 말이에요.

items.title: Missing the Bus
items.text:
A: Hello? I missed the school bus.
B: Where are you now?
A: At the bus stop on Pine Street.
B: Stay there. I'll drive you to school.
A: Thanks, but you'll be late for work.
B: It's OK. I'll call my office.
A: I'm sorry. I'll wake up earlier tomorrow.

qs.q: Where is A now?
qs.why: A가 "At the bus stop on Pine Street."라고 말했어요.

qs.q: Why did A probably miss the bus?
o: A went to the wrong street.
qs.why: A가 내일은 더 일찍 일어나겠다고 한 것으로 보아 늦게 일어났어요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, "call" means:
o: give a new name to something
qs.why: 사무실에 전화를 건다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does A say, "You'll be late for work"?
o: To ask what time it is
qs.why: B가 자신 때문에 직장에 늦을까 봐 걱정하는 말이에요.

items.title: Making Pancakes
items.text:
A: I'm hungry. Can we make pancakes?
B: Sure. First, we need eggs, milk, and flour.
A: I'll get the eggs. Where is the flour?
B: It's in the cabinet above the sink.
A: I can't reach it. It's too high.
B: Use the small stool. Be careful!

qs.q: Where is the flour?
o: In the fridge next to the milk
In the cabinet above the sink
On the stool by the table
Under the sink in the corner
qs.why: B가 "It's in the cabinet above the sink."라고 했어요.

qs.q: What can we guess about A?
o: A does not really like pancakes.
A already ate a big dinner.
A is too short for the cabinet.
A cannot find the eggs here.
qs.why: A가 너무 높아서 닿지 않는다고 했으니 키가 닿을 만큼 크지 않다고 짐작할 수 있어요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, "reach" means:
qs.why: 높은 선반에 손을 뻗어 닿는다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does B say, "Be careful!"
o: To say the food is hot
qs.why: 의자 위에 올라설 때 다치지 않도록 안전을 주의시키는 말이에요.

items.title: A Day at the Zoo
items.text:
A: Where did your class go yesterday?
B: We went to the zoo. We saw a baby panda.
A: Lucky! Was it sleeping?
B: No, it was eating bamboo.
A: What was your favorite animal?
B: The monkeys. They were funny, but they took a boy's hat!

qs.q: What was the baby panda doing?
qs.why: B가 "it was eating bamboo"라고 했어요.

qs.q: What is probably true about A?
o: A saw the baby panda too.
A took the boy's hat away.
A did not go to the zoo.
qs.why: A가 어디에 갔는지 묻고 "Lucky!"라고 한 것으로 보아 A는 동물원에 가지 않았어요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, "favorite" means:
qs.why: 가장 좋아하는 동물이 무엇인지 묻는 말이에요.

qs.q: Why does A say, "Lucky!"?
o: To say the panda is small
qs.why: 아기 판다를 본 B가 운이 좋다고 부러워하는 말이에요.

items.title: Forgotten Homework
items.text:
A: Mr. Kim, I'm sorry. I left my homework at home.
B: Thank you for telling me the truth.
A: Can I bring it tomorrow?
B: Yes, but please put it on my desk before class.
A: I will. I'll put it in my bag tonight.
B: Good. A reminder note might help too.

qs.q: Where should A put the homework tomorrow?
qs.why: B가 "put it on my desk before class"라고 했고 my desk는 선생님 책상이에요.

qs.q: How does B probably feel?
o: B is surprised by the news.
B is too busy to talk.
qs.why: B는 솔직하게 말해 줘서 고맙다고 하고 내일 가져오는 것을 허락해서 이해심이 있어요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, "left" means:
qs.why: 숙제를 집에 두고 왔다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does A ask, "Can I bring it tomorrow?"
o: To give the teacher an order
To offer to help the teacher
qs.why: 내일 가져와도 되는지 허락을 구하는 질문이에요.

items.title: Joining the Art Club
items.text:
A: Hi, you're new here, right? I'm Sam.
B: Yes, I'm Ari. I moved here last week.
A: Welcome! Do you like art?
B: I love it. I draw every day.
A: Our art club meets on Wednesdays. Would you like to join?
B: I'd love to! Where is the room?
A: Room 12, next to the music room.

qs.q: Where is the art club room?
qs.why: A가 "Room 12, next to the music room."이라고 했어요.

qs.q: What does B probably do on Wednesday?
qs.why: B가 동아리에 가입하고 싶다고 했으므로 수요일에 미술 동아리에 갈 거예요.

qs.q: In the dialogue, "moved" means:
qs.why: 이사 와서 새 곳에 살게 되었다는 뜻이에요.

qs.q: Why does A say, "Would you like to join?"
o: To invite B to the club
To say the club is full
qs.why: 새 친구에게 동아리에 가입하자고 권하는 말이에요.
